backup.production_rule: Expand only: two nullable text columns on public.booking_inquiries (paid_from_name, paid_from_channel) and two length checks that every existing row satisfies (all null). No data change, no grant change. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup, re-read the clock, then fill both (fill-restore-point.mjs does it). Take a fresh backup if the one named is more than an hour old at apply time.

forward_verification.name: payer_columns_exist_text_nullable_no_default
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 2 and bool_and(data_type = 'text' and is_nullable = 'YES' and column_default is null) from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'booking_inquiries' and column_name in ('paid_from_name','paid_from_channel')

forward_verification.name: length_checks_present_and_validated
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 2 and bool_and(convalidated) from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.booking_inquiries'::regclass and conname in ('booking_inquiries_paid_from_name_len_check','booking_inquiries_paid_from_channel_len_check')

forward_verification.name: no_existing_booking_has_a_payer_yet
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 0 from public.booking_inquiries where paid_from_name is not null or paid_from_channel is not null

forward_verification.name: refund_confirm_kind_already_allowed
forward_verification.query: select pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%refund_confirm%' from pg_constraint where conname = 'telegram_pending_kind_check'

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: Roll telegram-expense and upload-booking-receipt back first (the new code selects and writes the columns), then apply supabase/rollbacks/20261006_refund_destination.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh: it drops the two checks and the two columns. Take a backup first; dropping the columns loses the stored payer names.

feature_flags.name: sql_then_functions
feature_flags.required_state: Apply this release BEFORE deploying telegram-expense and upload-booking-receipt: /refund on a DIR code selects paid_from_name and paid_from_channel, and the receipt upload writes them. A function deployed first would fail the direct-booking lookup (refund cards for DIR codes say nothing was prepared) and log a payer-not-stored error on each receipt.

compatibility.rehearsal: NOT RUN YET (session 72 lane L3): the orchestrator rehearses on a restored backup and runs pgTAP refund_destination 14/14 before apply.
compatibility.evidence: Production read-only (2026-10-06): booking_inquiries has 18 columns and no payer column; telegram_pending_kind_check already lists refund_confirm (release 20261005100000). Old writers never set the new columns; they are nullable with no default.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
restore_point or verified_at is still empty or still the PENDING placeholder
the rehearsal has not run the pgTAP suite green on this commit
telegram-expense or upload-booking-receipt is deployed before this release is applied
